title: The Star That Blinked Back
logline: From the world of AFTER THE HUM: the night before Meridian went quiet, 14-year-old Lio maps a new star over the western mountains that blinks every seventeen seconds, notices every emergency speaker on Calder Row clicking on the same beat, and flashes his torch at it. Seventeen seconds later it answers.
hook_text: THIS STAR BLINKS ON A TIMER
cta_text: STAR OR SIGNAL? COMMENT YOUR THEORY
narrator_voice: Low, intimate and direct; restrained emotion and dry humor.

characters.name: Lio Calder
characters.tags: young boy, 14, short messy dark brown hair, round blue glasses, patched denim vest, red high-top shoes, constellation notebook
characters.bio: Nara's resourceful teenage neighbor, who notices what frightened adults overlook.

music: Dark ambient night score: low drones, faint distant rain, a soft high glassy tone that pulses like a far-off beacon, slow building tension, a cold unresolved rise near the end. Instrumental only, no vocals.

shots.location: Rooftop of a red brick apartment building on Calder Row, Meridian, at night
shots.framing: Medium shot, Lio seated by a rooftop water tank, his face clearly visible in the vertical center of the frame, the top fifth of the frame is empty dark sky
shots.background: Wet rooftop, rusty water tank, distant dark mountain ridge on the horizon with one tiny cold white point of light above it, low clouds
poses: Lio sits with an open notebook on his knees, staring up at the sky in awe, a pencil frozen in his hand
Lio leans forward, squinting at the horizon through his round blue glasses
Lio lifts the pencil and points it toward the distant light
Lio holds still, lips parted, eyes fixed on the light
shots.sfx: Light rain on a rooftop, distant city hum, faint wind.

shots.location: Night sky above the western mountains seen from the city
shots.framing: Vertical shot of only the sky and mountains, no people, a black mountain ridge silhouette across the lower third, one small bright cold white light just above the ridge in the center
shots.background: Heavy dark clouds, faint real stars, the single light glowing with a soft halo. No people, no figures, no buildings, no poles. Absolutely no people or faces anywhere in the image
poses: The single light glows bright with a soft white halo
The light is dim, almost gone, just a faint point
The light flares bright again, a thin halo spreading into the clouds
The light fades to a dim point again while clouds drift
shots.sfx: Quiet wind, a very faint high electronic tone pulsing once.

shots.framing: Close-up from above of an open notebook held in a boy's hands, no face in frame
shots.background: The notebook pages show hand-drawn star maps: pencil dots joined by thin lines, little circles, no words, no letters, no numbers. Wet rooftop gravel below
poses: A hand pencils a new small dot low on the page, below the other constellations
The pencil circles the new dot twice
The pencil draws a short arrow pointing to the dot
The hand rests on the page, the new dot circled
shots.sfx: Pencil scratching on paper, light rain.

shots.location: Rooftop over Calder Row, Meridian, at night
shots.framing: Wide vertical shot from behind and to the side, Lio small and alone near the roof edge, his profile visible
shots.background: Rain-dark city of Meridian below with warm window lights, an elevated rail line, red brick buildings, rooftop water tanks, the dark mountain ridge far away with a tiny light
poses: Lio sits alone at the roof edge, notebook on his knees, looking at the far mountains
Lio hugs his knees, notebook against his chest
Lio turns his head slightly, looking over his shoulder at the dark stairwell door
Lio looks back toward the mountains
shots.sfx: Distant elevated train rumble, rain, city hum.

shots.framing: Medium close-up of Lio, face centered in the middle of the frame, his raised hand beside his face
shots.background: Dark cloudy night sky, soft cold light on his face
poses: Lio counts on his fingers, lips moving, eyes on the sky
Lio folds down another finger, concentrating hard
Lio has all fingers folded, holding his breath
Lio's eyes widen as a faint white light flickers across his glasses
shots.sfx: Quiet rain, a soft clock-like tick.

shots.framing: Close-up of Lio's face, centered, slightly low angle
poses: Lio frowns and pushes his round blue glasses up his nose
Lio tilts his head, skeptical, one eyebrow raised
Lio mutters to himself, unsettled
Lio stares upward, serious

shots.location: Calder Row street seen from the rooftop at night
shots.framing: High angle looking straight down the narrow street, vertical composition
shots.background: Rain-black street, red brick apartments, a glowing blue laundromat sign, elevated rail shadows, grey emergency loudspeaker horns mounted on street poles, wet reflections, no people. Absolutely no people or faces anywhere in the image
poses: The street is still, the loudspeakers on their poles
Tiny red indicator lights blink on every loudspeaker at once
The red lights are off again, rain streaking past
The red lights blink on again all together
shots.sfx: Rain on the street, a sharp synchronized electrical click from many speakers.

shots.framing: Close-up of one grey emergency loudspeaker horn on a pole, angled up toward distant mountains
shots.background: Rain, red brick wall, the dark mountain ridge far behind with a faint light. Absolutely no people or faces anywhere in the image
poses: The speaker horn points toward the far mountains, a small red light glowing
The red light switches off
The red light glows again
Rain drips off the speaker rim, red light off
shots.sfx: A single electrical click, rain dripping on metal.

shots.framing: Vertical shot across empty rooftops, no people, perspective leading to the far mountains
shots.background: Many grey emergency loudspeaker horns on rooftop masts, all turned the same direction toward the dark western mountains, each with a small red light, rain, low clouds. No people, no figures anywhere. Absolutely no people or faces anywhere in the image
poses: All the speakers face the mountains, red lights glowing together
All the red lights are dark
All the red lights glow again in unison
The lights are dark, the faint mountain light glows on the horizon
shots.sfx: Many speakers clicking in unison, wind.

shots.framing: Medium shot of Lio standing, his face clearly visible in the center of the frame
shots.background: Rooftop water tank, dark cloudy sky, mountains on the horizon
poses: Lio stands and raises a small handheld flashlight toward the sky, determined
Lio clicks the flashlight on, a short white beam into the sky
The flashlight is off, Lio waits, jaw tight
Lio lowers the flashlight slightly, watching the horizon

shots.framing: Close-up of Lio's face in the center of the frame
poses: Lio's face is lit by a sudden cold white flash from far away, eyes wide behind his glasses
The flash is gone, Lio's face in darkness, mouth open
Another cold white flash lights his face, a white point reflected in his glasses
Darkness again, Lio frozen in shock
shots.sfx: A low distant tonal pulse, rain stops for a moment.

shots.framing: Close-up of Lio, face centered, notebook clutched to his chest
shots.background: Dark sky, the faint distant light over the mountain ridge behind him
poses: Lio whispers, clutching the notebook to his chest, eyes on the horizon
Lio slowly lowers the flashlight, breathing hard
Lio swallows, glancing at the notebook
Lio looks straight at the horizon, afraid but curious

line.text: That's not a star. It's answering.

shots.sfx: Wind, a faint high tone fading.
